description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

Ortelan is hiring a Full Stack Engineer to build and improve its AI products, including Praus and Lost Tribes. The role spans user interfaces, backend services, model routing, retrieval, and agent features, with frequent shipping and user feedback informing product decisions.
Full Stack Engineer building end-to-end AI product interfaces and services, integrating APIs, retrieval, and model-routing and agent features

Responsibilities:
• Build product features end to end, from the interface to the backend
• Design interfaces for AI products that show their sources, handle uncertainty and stay fast
• Build the services behind them, including APIs, data models, background jobs and integrations
• Work with model routing, retrieval and agent features alongside our AI engineers
• Make the products fast, reliable and affordable to run
• Talk to users and use what you learn to improve the product

Requirements:
• Have 0 to 3 years of experience building web products, with work you can show us
• Write production code in TypeScript and are comfortable with React and a backend language such as Node or Python
• Care about how a product feels to use, down to the details
• Have built something with language models, or want to
• Work well remotely and set your own direction

Preferred:
• Real-time features such as streaming, chat or collaboration
• Postgres, queues and cloud infrastructure
• Shipping AI features in a consumer or business product
• Startups, side projects or open-source work
